    local timeout=$2
    local elapsed=0
    while ps -p "$pid" > /dev/null 2>&1; do
        if [ "$elapsed" -ge "$timeout" ]; then
            log "[WARN] PID $pid still alive after ${timeout}s timeout"
            return 1
        fi
        sleep 10

log "Salvage monitor started. Watching PIDs: ${PIDS[*]}"

        rm -f "${EVAL_DIR}/.done_salvage_"* "${EVAL_DIR}/.launched_salvage_"*

    fi

done
